name: x402-seller-mcp
description: Pay-per-call access to x402-seller's paid API endpoints (crypto prices, DeFi data, on-chain reads, web reading, AI tasks) in USDC on Base — no API key.
long_description:
Turns every paid endpoint of x402-seller (https://x402-seller-0ay3.onrender.com) into an MCP tool, generated at startup from its own x402 discovery document — so the tool list stays correct as endpoints change.

Works in two modes:

- **No wallet configured**: calling a tool returns an explanation of the 402 payment challenge (price, network, how to pay) instead of the real result.
- **Wallet configured** (via the Buyer wallet private key setting below): calls are paid automatically over x402 and return the real result plus the settlement receipt (payer address, transaction hash).

Only ever configure a throwaway wallet funded with a small amount of USDC on Base — never a wallet holding significant funds.

buyer_private_key.title: Buyer wallet private key (optional)
buyer_private_key.description: EVM private key (0x...) of a THROWAWAY wallet funded with a small amount of USDC on Base. Leave empty to use explain-only mode (tool calls describe the payment required instead of paying). Never use a wallet holding significant funds.
